name: Highland

eraModifiers.text: Wilder weather: flood repairs cost 3 materials, and a storm can damage 2 exposed buildings.
Long winters: homes need 1 more heat on winter nights.

biome.reason: a cold glen to winter in

flood.name: Snowmelt
flood.summary: melt water floods the glen floor beside the stream
flood.description: The snow melts on the tops and the stream floods the glen floor beside it. Buildings there that aren't flood-tolerant are disabled for the season and cost 2 materials to repair. No silt: the melt is cold and fast.

lowRiver.name: Dry spell
lowRiver.summary: the stream runs low; farms far from water lose half their food
lowRiver.description: A dry summer: the stream runs low, and farms more than 2 tiles from water lose half their summer yield.

storm.name: Gale
storm.summary: wind rises; two exposed buildings on the tops may be damaged
storm.description: Wind rises on the tops; two exposed buildings (on a crag, or at height 3) are disabled for the season unless pine wood or a snow fence shelters them.

freeze.name: Deep snow
freeze.summary: snow on the tops; homes need heat
freeze.description: Deep snow: homes need heat, more of it up high, and solar panels up high are snowed under.

combos.name: Busy Bees
combos.text: An apiary next to terrace or glen farms: +1 food on each of up to 3, spring to autumn. A wind spire next door scares the bees off.
combos.hint: Bees work the fields around them.

combos.name: Hearth Stones
combos.text: A bothy next to a heat well: its stove needs no biomass.
combos.hint: A warm store beside a cold hearth.

combos.name: High Pasture
combos.text: A shieling next to 2 meadow tiles: +1 food in summer.
combos.hint: Summer grazing wants open grass around it.

combos.name: Quiet Spire
combos.text: A pollinator meadow next to a wind spire cancels the spire's Harmony penalty.
combos.hint: Flowers soften the hum of the wind spires.

combos.name: Kiln Warmth
combos.text: A kiln next to a heat well charges it for free: 1 heat each run.
combos.hint: A kiln's waste heat can be kept for winter.

combos.name: Green Doorstep
combos.text: A cottage next to meadow or woodland: +1 wellbeing each season.
combos.hint: People like to live near green land.

combos.name: Kitchen Loop
combos.text: Farm → scraps and biomass → composter → compost → farm. Once it runs, every building in the loop makes +1 (farms food, the composter compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Put a composter among working farms.

combos.name: Gas Loop
combos.text: Farm biomass → digester → night power, digestate back to the farms. Once it runs, every building in the loop makes +1 (farms food, the digester compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: A digester feeding the night, among working farms.

combos.name: Carbon Loop
combos.text: Coppice wood → biomass → biochar kiln → charcoal → farm, in a chain of neighbours. Once it runs, every building in the loop makes +1 (food, biomass or compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Wood the kiln chars, beside the field it feeds.

combos.name: Meltwater Loop
combos.text: Rewetted bog → water → pump station → terrace farm, in a chain of neighbours. Once it runs, the pump lifts 1 more water up its step, the terrace makes +1 food, and the glen +1 Harmony, for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: A bog holds the melt; a pump beside it lifts it to the terraces.

combos.name: River Loop
combos.text: Fish pond → nutrient water → greenhouse → biomass → digester, in a chain of neighbours. Once it runs, each makes +1 (food, or the digester's compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Pond water feeds a greenhouse; its waste feeds a digester.

combos.name: Bath Loop
combos.text: Kiln or heat well → heat → bathhouse → grey water → reed bed, in a chain of neighbours. It closes when the bathhouse takes its heat from the kiln or well next to it and the reed bed next to it cleans grey water. Once it runs, the kiln makes +1 materials and the reed bed +1 biomass for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Warm the bath with a neighbour's spare heat; let reeds clean what it lets out.

combos.name: Heat Cascade
combos.text: Heat runs from hot to warm, losing some at each step: a kiln or heat well warms the bathhouse next to it, and the bathhouse's warm water heats the greenhouse next to it (up to 1 heat a slot). It closes the first winter the greenhouse is warmed that way. Once it runs, the kiln makes +1 materials and the greenhouse +1 food for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Spare heat from a hot neighbour can warm two buildings, not one.

combos.name: Mushroom Loop
combos.text: Farm → biomass → mushroom cellar → spent substrate (compost) → farm. It closes when a working cellar stands next to a working farm. Once it runs, both make +1 food for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: What a farm leaves, mushrooms eat; what mushrooms leave, a farm eats.

combos.name: Village Green
combos.text: A Commons Plaza ringed by 6 buildings of at least 3 kinds: +2 wellbeing each season.
combos.hint: A gathering place, surrounded on every side by a varied neighbourhood.

combos.name: Sun Terrace
combos.text: 3 solar canopies in a row, all on the slopes (height 1 or more): each makes +1 day energy every season.
combos.hint: Panels stepping in a straight line up the glen.

combos.name: Wildway
combos.text: An unbroken strip of meadow and woodland from the river to the valley's edge: +10 Harmony, and animals return.
combos.hint: A green corridor from the water to the hills.

combos.name: Keyhole Garden
combos.text: A composter with 3 farms next to it: its compost doubles.
combos.hint: A heap at the heart of the beds.

combos.name: Water Stair
combos.text: A pump station with 2 terrace farms in a straight line above it, each a step higher: each terrace makes +1 food in a season it makes any.
combos.hint: Terraces climbing straight up from a pump.

combos.name: Snow Line
combos.text: 4 snow fences joined end to end along the edges between tiles: gales can’t damage any building within 2 tiles of them.
combos.hint: A long fence stops more wind than a short one.

combos.name: Ridge Spires
combos.text: 3 wind spires in a row at height 2 or 3: each makes +1 energy in every slot, and they cost no Harmony.
combos.hint: Blades along the ridge, where only the wind lives.

combos.name: Hearth Square
combos.text: A bathhouse, a Commons Plaza and a cottage, each touching the other two: +5 wellbeing in winter.
combos.hint: Somewhere warm to gather when it's cold.

combos.name: Winter Garden
combos.text: A greenhouse next to a heat well becomes a Winter Garden: the well keeps it warm, so it needs no heat in winter and makes 4 food then instead of 3.
combos.hint: Glass that never gets cold.

combos.name: Treehouse Commons
combos.text: A cottage next to 2 woodland tiles becomes a Treehouse Commons: +2 wellbeing each season instead of +1.
combos.hint: A home among the trees.

combos.name: Aquaponics Hall
combos.text: A greenhouse next to a fish pond becomes an Aquaponics Hall: 4 food every season, watered by the pond's nutrient-rich water instead of a channel. It still needs 2 day energy. Next to a heat well too, choose it or the Winter Garden.
combos.hint: Fish feed the plants; the plants clean the fishes' water.

combos.name: Canal-top Solar
combos.text: A solar canopy built over a channel becomes Canal-top Solar: water still flows beneath, the whole channel loses nothing to summer evaporation, and the panels make 1 more energy by day in summer, kept cool by the water.
combos.hint: Shade the water, cool the panels.

combos.name: Singing Spire
combos.text: A wind spire with pollinator meadows on 2 sides becomes a Singing Spire: no Harmony penalty, and +1 wellbeing each season.
combos.hint: Wind through flowers makes music.

combos.name: Old World Archive
combos.text: A salvage yard whose ruin is empty, next to a Seedbank Library, may become an Old World Archive instead of a Rewilded Ruin: +2 knowledge each season, with 1 worker. You choose.
combos.hint: Not everything worth keeping in a ruin is metal.

combos.name: Coppice Wood
combos.text: Coppice a woodland tile next to a workshop and it becomes a Coppice Wood: 2 materials each season with 1 worker, but it counts as meadow for Harmony (1 instead of 2). Stop coppicing and it is woodland again after 2 seasons.
combos.hint: Cut a tree low and it grows back many.

combos.name: Hanging Garden
combos.text: A terrace farm next to 2 terraces and a pollinator meadow becomes a Hanging Garden: +1 food, +1 Harmony, and it needs no worker.
combos.hint: Terraces among terraces, with flowers for the bees.

combos.name: Cascade
combos.text: 2 hill turbines next to each other down the stream become a Cascade: each makes +1 energy in spring and autumn, by day and by night.
combos.hint: One wheel’s water turns the next.

combos.name: Bat Roost
combos.text: A salvage yard whose old mine is empty becomes a Bat Roost: +2 Harmony, and its worker is free.
combos.hint: What lives in a mine when the miners leave?

tunings.name: Mirror Film
tunings.text: Solar canopies make +1 energy in winter.

tunings.name: Night Shift
tunings.text: Workshops get a 3rd run, on night energy only.

tunings.name: Hive Mind
tunings.text: Apiaries reach 2 tiles.

tunings.name: Kiln Loop
tunings.text: Kilns recover their own heat: each firing needs 1 energy instead of 2.

tunings.name: Brighter Panels
tunings.text: Solar canopies make +1 day energy in spring and summer.

tunings.name: Balanced Blades
tunings.text: Wind spires make +1 energy by day and night in summer.

tunings.name: Insulated Homes
tunings.text: Cottages and treehouses need no heat on winter nights.

tunings.name: Bigger Larders
tunings.text: Cottages store 5 more food.

tunings.name: Loft Rooms
tunings.text: Cottages house 1 more citizen.

tunings.name: Lean Workshops
tunings.text: Each workshop run needs 1 energy instead of 2.

tunings.name: Deep Cells
tunings.text: Cell banks hold 2 more energy.

tunings.name: Hot Compost
tunings.text: A full composter makes 3 compost instead of 2.

tunings.name: Reading Rooms
tunings.text: Seedbank libraries make +1 knowledge every season.

tunings.name: Busy Bees
tunings.text: Each apiary helps 1 more neighbouring farm or orchard.

tunings.name: Festival Nights
tunings.text: A powered Commons Plaza gives +1 more wellbeing.

tunings.name: Heat Recovery
tunings.text: Each kiln firing sends 1 more heat to a neighbouring heat well.

tunings.name: Deeper Heat Wells
tunings.text: Heat wells hold 2 more heat.

tunings.name: Dry-stone Terraces
tunings.text: Terrace farms can’t be damaged by gales.

tunings.name: Hardy Oats
tunings.text: Terrace farms make 1 food in winter.

tunings.name: Steeper Wheels
tunings.text: Hill turbines make +1 energy in summer, by day and by night.

tunings.name: Thick Walls
tunings.text: Homes high up need extra heat only in winter, not in autumn.

tunings.name: Wool Trade
tunings.text: Shielings make +1 food in autumn.

tunings.name: Wider Watch
tunings.text: Lookouts shelter everything within 3 tiles from gales, not 2.

tunings.name: Stronger Pumps
tunings.text: Pump stations lift 1 more water up their step.

charters.name: Repair Culture
charters.text: Salvage ×2: each salvage yard makes 6 a season from the same ruin. Workshops turn 2 clutter into 2 materials.

charters.name: River Keepers
charters.text: Floods do no damage; fish ponds make +1 food.

charters.name: Night Market
charters.text: +2 wellbeing each season the night slot is fully powered.

charters.name: Rewilders
charters.text: Tree nurseries improve a neighbouring tile 2 steps a season; pollinator meadows give +1 more Harmony.

charters.name: Mountain Rescue
charters.text: Gales do no damage; lookouts give +1 wellbeing more.

charters.name: Hearth Keepers
charters.text: Bothies’ stoves need no biomass; bothies house 1 more.

visions.name: Restore the Glen
visions.text: Make 60% of the glen's healable land meadow or woodland.

visions.name: Lantern of the Glen
visions.text: Go a full year, spring to winter, with 30 or more citizens and no shortfall in any slot.

visions.name: Thriving Commons
visions.text: Reach 50 citizens with wellbeing 70 or more.

projects.name: Green Terraces
projects.text: Compost worked into the worst ground: when finished, the 8 least healthy tiles of land each improve one step.

projects.name: Biochar Beds
projects.text: Biomass buried as charcoal feeds the soil for good: +6 Harmony from then on.

projects.name: Seed Vault
projects.text: The valley's seeds, catalogued and kept: +25 to the run's score.

projects.name: Festival Grounds
projects.text: A meadow stage for the turning seasons: +2 wellbeing every season from then on.

projects.name: The Long Bridge
projects.text: A timber bridge across the whole reach: +40 to the run's score.

projects.name: Sky Garden
projects.text: Terraced gardens climbing the hills: +12 Harmony and +1 wellbeing every season from then on.

projects.name: Gift to Root City
projects.text: Seed stock, tools and stories sent ahead: +6 Seeds when the run is sent home.

wildlife.name: Mountain Hares
wildlife.text: Mountain hares come at Harmony 20 to open meadow at height 2 or higher. In summer, shielings within 2 tiles of them make 1 more food.

wildlife.name: Dippers
wildlife.text: Dippers come at Harmony 40 to the stream beside a hill turbine. Fish ponds within 2 tiles of them make 1 more food.

wildlife.name: Golden Eagles
wildlife.text: Golden eagles come at Harmony 50 to a lookout with another crag beside it. Each lookout they nest by gives 1 wellbeing every season.

wildlife.name: Pine Martens
wildlife.text: Pine martens come at Harmony 70 to pine woods of 4 or more tiles with nothing built on them. Each such wood gives 1 wellbeing every season.

festivals.name: Snowmelt Fair
festivals.text: A spring fair as the snow goes. +3 wellbeing, and the melt fills every cistern and bog to the brim.

festivals.name: Shieling Day
festivals.text: A summer day driving the flocks up to the high pastures. +3 wellbeing, and every shieling makes 1 more food this summer.

festivals.name: Lantern Night
festivals.text: A winter night of lanterns. +3 wellbeing if no night this season runs short of energy, and the glen’s animals come out to see.

twists.name: Fair Weather
twists.text: No twist: the seasons as usual.

twists.name: Wild Storms
twists.text: Gales can damage 3 buildings anywhere on open land, not just the tops (pine wood or a snow fence beside them still shelters them), the Mixed Grid can’t stop them, and each repair costs 3 materials. The Graft is one tier higher.

twists.name: Steady Winds
twists.text: Wind spires make 1 more energy by day and night, but storms can damage 2 exposed buildings.

twists.name: Lean Start
twists.text: The Sprout sets out with 5 materials, 4 food and 4 citizens. The Graft is one tier higher.

twists.name: Big Families
twists.text: Citizens arrive two at a time, but only when a season's harvest leaves 4 food spare after eating (usually 2).

twists.name: Scavengers' Glen
twists.text: Old mines hold 12 more salvage each (42 instead of 30), but every clutter costs 2 Harmony.

twists.name: Deep Winter
twists.text: Snow from autumn: solar canopies at height 2 or 3 make nothing in autumn as well as winter. The Graft is one tier higher.

twists.name: Föhn Wind
twists.text: A warm wind off the tops: homes need 1 less heat on winter nights, but the snowmelt floods twice as far (up to 2 tiles from the stream, and at height 1).

twists.name: Late Thaw
twists.text: Spring stays in deep snow, and the snowmelt comes in summer instead of the dry spell.

regions.name: The Glen
regions.text: The glen as it is: a stream falling down the middle, slopes to the crags on either side, bogs and old mines on the shoulders.

regions.name: Corrie Lochs
regions.text: Two mountain tarns at height 2, which the snowmelt fills each spring: water high up without pumping it there.

regions.name: High Plateau
regions.text: The land climbs fast from the stream: most of it at heights 2 and 3, cold and windy, and the camp close by the water. The Graft is one tier higher.

regions.name: Old Pinewood
regions.text: Remnants of the old pine forest: 6 woods where the glen has 3.

regions.name: Old Mines
regions.text: A mining glen: 7 old workings, and fuller (36 salvage each).

eraGoals.text: Go a full year, spring to winter, with no energy shortfall.

levels.name: Bitter Nights
levels.text: Homes need 1 more heat on winter nights.

levels.name: Quick Clutter
levels.text: Citizens make scraps faster: one for every 2 citizens instead of 3.

levels.name: Slow Healing
levels.text: Spreading compost takes 4 compost per step of healing instead of 2.

levels.name: Restless People
levels.text: The population grows only at wellbeing 70 or more, instead of 60.

levels.name: Cold Autumns
levels.text: Homes need 1 more heat on autumn nights.

levels.name: Rough Seasons
levels.text: Flood repairs cost 2 more materials, and storms can damage one more exposed building.

levels.name: Weary People
levels.text: Meeting every need no longer lifts wellbeing.

levels.name: High Hopes
levels.text: Civic life serves 10 fewer citizens before expectations cost wellbeing.

intro: New: the Highland. The land rises in steps from the glen floor to the tops. Water flows only downhill: a Pump Station lifts it a step to the terraces. Up high, homes need more heat in autumn and winter, wind spires make more and solar is snowed under in winter; heat needs a building nearby. Each spring the snowmelt floods the glen floor beside the stream.
